summary: Highlights lootable containers with configurable text markers, optional tinting, and in-game Mod Hub controls.
details: Container Highlight is an RE_Kenshi plugin for making nearby lootable containers easier to spot while the highlight key is held.
Screen-space markers can show configurable text and icon styling, including marker text, marker color, and a readable outlined label.
Optional container tinting helps valid containers stand out in the world when Kenshi exposes a tintable render path.
Mod Hub integration provides in-game controls for the highlight key, marker display, marker color, tint color, distance, and advanced debug actions.
